card.text: Elongated comet that Deep Space 1 flew past in 2001.

introduction.text: Borrelly found this comet at Marseilles in 1904. Close-up images show smooth plains, rough slopes and a narrow waist.

micas.title: Encounter photograph
micas.summary: The mission team's orthophoto laid onto USGS terrain, keeping Deep Space 1's lighting.

usgs.title: USGS stereo terrain
usgs.summary: Terrain from overlapping MICAS images, checked by hand in stereo. The far side is an estimated shape.

dlr.title: DLR stereo terrain
dlr.summary: An independent stereo terrain from the same images, aligned with the USGS model.

height.title: Above the image plane
height.summary: Height toward the spacecraft from the source's reference plane, not from the comet's center.

difference.title: USGS minus DLR
difference.summary: USGS height minus DLR height after alignment: disagreement between models, not change over time.
